bot.gw.kernel_ask: 🚀 Switch to the AmneziaWG kernel module? This installs a compiler and kernel headers (≈200 MB), builds for 1–3 min, then runs a self-test. {reconnect} Settings are backed up before the switch; if the clients don’t come back within 3 minutes, AmneziaWG goes back to userspace. Risks: a bug in the module brings down the whole server kernel, not one process; the module rebuilds itself when the kernel is updated.

The domain will show an ordinary site from the catalog of free templates (a random one), and the web panel will move to a secret address on this domain. Kaskad will install nginx, take ports 80 and 443/tcp and switch the certificate renewal itself. Takes 1–3 minutes.
